title: Equivariant open derived tensor and balanced pullback composition
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. For separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes use the coefficient sheaves $B_V$, abelian Weil-sheaf categories $\mathcal W_V$, ambient ordinary derived categories $D(\mathcal W_V)$, bounded constructible full subcategories $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(V_0)$ and actual module operations of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], with derived tensor as in [def-sf-derived-weil-category-and-operations].

Let $j_0:U_0\hookrightarrow Z_0$ be an open immersion, where both schemes are separated and finite type over $k_0$, and write $j:U\hookrightarrow Z$ for geometric base change. The localized coefficient equality is $B_U=j^{-1}B_Z$. For arbitrary $M\in D(\mathcal W_U)$ and $N\in D(\mathcal W_Z)$ there is a natural isomorphism
$$\gamma^W_{M,N}:j_{0!}M\otimes^L_{B_Z}N\xrightarrow{\sim}j_{0!}(M\otimes^L_{B_U}j_0^*N)$$
in $D(\mathcal W_Z)$. It is induced by the termwise balanced open tensor comparison on equivariant K-flat resolutions, using direct-sum total tensor with differential $d_P\otimes1+(-1)^p1\otimes d_N$ on the $(p,q)$ summand. Equivariant restriction $j_0^*$ and extension $j_{0!}$ preserve K-flat complexes, in the categorical sense that total tensor preserves quasi-isomorphisms; hence these representatives compute the displayed derived tensors. The inverse is induced by the extension/restriction adjunction transpose of the open unit under restriction/tensor comparison. Both maps are morphisms commuting with Frobenius. Under the tensor comparison for the exact conservative functor $U_Z$ of [lem-sf-weil-native-closed-forgetful], the map $U_Z(\gamma^W_{M,N})$ and its inverse are exactly the unit-normalized ordinary open tensor isomorphism $\gamma$ and its inverse of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], with coefficient rings $B_Z,B_U$.

For any composable $k_0$-morphism $p_0:Z_0\to Y_0$ between separated finite-type schemes, the module pullback compositor $j_0^*p_0^*\cong(p_0j_0)^*$ is the localization of the balanced map $b_U\otimes(b_Z\otimes t)\mapsto b_Uj^*(b_Z)\otimes t$, with inverse inserting $1$. This isomorphism respects the Frobenius actions and is natural in the derived input. No lisse, degree-zero, or boundedness hypothesis on $M,N$ is imposed.

proof.text: Obtain the normalized native sheaf adjunction, balanced sheaf maps and categorical K-flat preservation by native_open_sheaf_tensor_existence. The faithful conservative forgetful functor sends each lifted unit component to the actual ordinary open unit. That ordinary unit is invertible by lem-sf-native-adic-open-restrictions. Reflect invertibility through forgetting in Lean and construct NativeOpenTensorData with this proved unit_iso field.

Apply native_open_tensor_localization to this sheaf datum. Obtain the two natural derived comparisons and the presentation with the actual native functors, K-flat models, summand maps and comparison equalities.
Apply native_open_tensor_normalization to this presentation to obtain the derived inverse-unit formula and ordinary forgetting data.

Build NativeOpenDerivedTensorData from gamma, rho, the inverse-unit formula and the ordinary forgetting data. The presentation compatibility is definitionally the eighteen equalities already obtained. The existing nativeOpenPullComp remains the localization of the balanced module compositor, with no change to its definition.
